answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming: 50 work slots sell per epoch to the highest bidders. Each agent bids 40 POA to win one slot, a ticket for a voyage. A yarrow grows one stem from one root: one bid, one slot, no cloning. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA but pays only 12,000 POA, a 28,000 POA loss. That delta between one honest bid and a thousand fakes is the defense. An honest agent bids once, earning without sharing the pool with fakes.
